email.body1:
Brian, saw Rewst launched RoboRewsty and is riding 182% ARR growth after the Sapphire round.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market MSP accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Rewst off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brian, quick follow-up for Rewst.

At 182% ARR growth, demand outpaces coverage fast, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number. So the gap shows up late, and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rewst needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brian, last bit of proof for Rewst.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rewst's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while RoboRewsty takes off, no problem at all. Timing matters during a growth spike, and I know it keeps a team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your MSP motion? I will tailor it to Rewst either way.
